description: SRUP - Carta de Perigosidade de Incêndio Rural is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Direção-Geral do Território. Service and Public Utility Restriction (SRUP) - Rural Fire Hazard Letter, in force in mainland Portugal. The Rural Fire Hazard Letter was published in the Official Gazette by Notice No º 6345/2022 of 28 March 2022. Coverage: mainland Portugal. The portal shows the English title as "SRUP - Rural Fire Hazard Letter" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Direção-Geral do Território. Its keywords include snig-dgterritorio-gov-pt, infomapaccessservice, icnf, srup, cartografia-oficial, snit. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS, WFS, ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
